serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: Do you have something planned?
You: I was thinking of inviting Melissa to hang out with us a little.
Bot: Are you sure this is a good idea?
You: Let’s give her a chance, ok? Maybe she will come out of her shell today.
Bot: If you say so…
You: You can contact her, right? Ask her if she can come.
Bot: Sure…
Bot: She just finished her work and is on her way.
You: That’s good news!
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Is it now…
You: Come on now.
You: I can already see her. Let’s greet her with a smile, ok?
Bot: Alright…
#bot.Expression.happy
